name: PlayerComponentReplicatedState
summary: The payload carried by state fragment type index 3935 (key 9) in the local-player record: a two-level presence mask over the registered player-state members, then the members it selects. MEASURED SUBSET ONLY. The type is resolved by the type-index varint (0xf5f) to the AZ id bddda784-a6e7-416b-a041-449920d90fb6, whose record function 0x1468174b0 installs facet vtable 0x14851e0d8; facet slot +8 = 0x14657acd0 constructs the class at vtable 0x148558f30 (ctor 0x146713160). The dispatcher therefore calls that class's +0x88 writer and +0x90 reader, the shared replicated-state two-level mask pair. The ctor registers two groups; the 3-byte body sets group 1 member 3 only, which this card models. The other eight group-1 members and the group-0 members are NOT declared, because no body in hand sets them; the codec refuses an undeclared bit rather than skipping it.
